nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: C-ABI entry: argv capture, crash handler, mimalloc global allocator, stdio, StackCheck, then Cli::start

nodes.label: Cli::start
nodes.desc: inline(never) startup chain head; sets start time, inits Log and CLI arena, dispatches Command::start

nodes.label: Run::boot
nodes.desc: Runs bun_jsc::initialize then VirtualMachine::init; wires dotenv, transpiler defines, sql/redis preconnect

nodes.label: bun_jsc::initialize
nodes.desc: JSCInitialize over bun_sys environ; runtime dispatch hooks were installed earlier by main

nodes.label: VirtualMachine::init
nodes.desc: Builds per-thread VM: transpiler with resolver, ModuleLoader, regular + macro EventLoop, JSC global object

nodes.label: VirtualMachine
nodes.desc: Value fields: transpiler, module_loader, transpiler_store, regular_event_loop, macro_event_loop, event_loop self-pointer

nodes.label: Run::start
nodes.desc: Grabs the JSC API lock and never drops it; adds conditional globals, loads entry, then the core run-loop

nodes.label: core run-loop
nodes.desc: while vm.is_event_loop_alive() { vm.tick(); vm.auto_tick_active(); } then on_before_exit / on_exit

nodes.label: load_entry_point
nodes.desc: reload_entry_point + spin: ticks the loop while the entry promise is pending, wait_for_promise otherwise

nodes.label: reload_entry_point
nodes.desc: Single funnel for main entry, workers and evals: pre-execution bootstrap, preload scripts, built-in entries

nodes.label: JSModuleLoader
nodes.desc: Rust FFI wrapper over JSC's JSModuleLoader: loadAndEvaluateModule, resolveAndLoadAndEvaluateModule, import

nodes.label: fetchESMSourceCode
nodes.desc: C++ loader fetch: builtin check, CommonJS module objects, plugins, then the Rust transpile hook

nodes.label: Bun__fetchBuiltinModule
nodes.desc: Serves node:, bun: and internal: builtins from the codegen'd builtin registry; enforce trimmed modules

nodes.label: Bun__getDefaultLoader
nodes.desc: Picks a loader from the import type attribute or the file extension via transpiler.options.loader

nodes.label: __bun_transpile_source_code
nodes.desc: Runtime-transpiler entry: read file, Transpiler::parse, js_printer::print, ResolvedSource with is_static

nodes.label: Bun__transpileVirtualModule
nodes.desc: Plugin and virtual module sources go through the same transpiler path

nodes.label: Transpiler
nodes.desc: Formerly the whole transpiler; now per-VM options + resolver + linker, shared with bundle_v2

nodes.label: Transpiler::parse
nodes.desc: parse_maybe_return_file_only chain down to parse_internal: lexer, parser, lowering, import records

nodes.label: Transpiler::print
nodes.desc: Prints the AST back to JS through bun_js_printer with optional source maps

nodes.label: BufferPrinter
nodes.desc: Writer<BufferWriter> aliased as BufferPrinter; one per VM shared by the runtime transpiler

nodes.label: RuntimeTranspilerStore
nodes.desc: Caches transpiled outputs; RuntimeTranspilerCache adds a disk-backed entry layer

nodes.label: ResolvedSource
nodes.desc: The contract handed back to JSC: printed code, source URL, tag, module type

nodes.label: EventLoop
nodes.desc: FIFO task queue, two immediate queues, yield_tasks, concurrent queues, deferred tasks, uws loop handle

nodes.label: EventLoop::tick
nodes.desc: tick_turn under a top scope; increments entered_event_loop_count, folds task exceptions

nodes.label: tick_turn
nodes.desc: Bounded refill loop: tick_with_count, drain_microtasks_with_global, handle_rejected_promises

nodes.label: drain_microtasks_and_next_ticks
nodes.desc: One microtask checkpoint via JSC__JSGlobalObject__drainMicrotasks: nextTicks then the JSC microtask queue

nodes.label: auto_tick
nodes.desc: Promotes immediates and yield_tasks, polls I/O while the loop stays alive

nodes.label: tick_possibly_forever
nodes.desc: Watcher arm driver: uws tick_with_timeout(1s bound), on_after_event_loop, tick

nodes.label: MiniEventLoop
nodes.desc: Isolated loop for spawnSync and early boot, init_global before the VM exists

nodes.label: AnyEventLoop
nodes.desc: Lower-tier handle over erased *mut jsc::EventLoop via link-time extern Rust, no vtable

nodes.label: bun:ffi mod
nodes.desc: Bun.FFI crate module: ABIType formatters, DOMCall slowpath exports, FFIObject

nodes.label: Function::compile
nodes.desc: TinyCC-backed Function::compile and dlopen; callbacks wrap into JSC host functions

nodes.label: FFIObject
nodes.desc: FFIObject with lazy Reader/Pointer views; DOMJIT fast paths with Rust slowpath shims
